name: Sweden

observations.reasoning: Sourced on 2026-07-27, transversal pass over the population indicator. Population on 1 January 2025: 10587710 inhabitants, recorded as 10.588 million. Eurostat dataset demo_pjan, Population on 1 January by age and sex, read through the dissemination API on 2026-07-27, dataset last updated 2026-07-09. Total population, both sexes, all ages, which is exactly what this indicator's denominator asks for. Read as one table covering every country in the record, so no value here is derived from a neighbour: each is that country's own row. The previous value was an opening estimate produced with no source and no research.

Collected on 2026-07-28, in Swedish, in the transversal venues pass, and corrected the same day after the first count reached three and stopped in Stockholm. Five units, four houses and one stage, against an opening estimate of 2.5 produced with no research. The correction is the useful part and it came from the right list. The first pass built its candidates from what the Stockholm institutions and the county theatres publish, which found the capital and nothing else. UNIMA Sverige keeps a directory of Swedish puppet groups and marks which of them hold a stage, and reading it produced two houses outside Stockholm immediately. Any count of a country like this one is only as wide as the directory it starts from. In Stockholm: Dockteatern Tittut has held its own stage at Lundagatan 33 by Zinkensdamm since 1994, was founded in 1977 by Ing-Mari Tirén and Eva Gumpert as the first theatre in the world made for children from the age of two, and names Kulturrådet, Stockholms Stad and Region Stockholm together — state, city and region, which is as clean as the backing test gets anywhere in this record. Pygméteatern has a fixed stage on Vegagatan by Odenplan, has worked in puppetry since Sten Wallin and Michael Koitzsch founded it in 1976, pioneered modern shadow theatre in Sweden and now mixes puppets, shadow play and actors; it draws most of its money from touring and carries Kultur Stockholm and the county, its Kulturrådet grant having been withdrawn some years ago. That withdrawal is recorded rather than hidden. Outside it: Teater Sesam has been at Chapmans torg 2 in Majorna, Göteborg, since 1991, having started in 1987, and holds two stages of its own — a smaller one for the youngest and a larger one for schoolchildren and adults — beside workshops and studios; its expression rests mainly on puppet and shadow theatre, it plays over two hundred performances a year, and it carries operational support from Statens kulturråd and Göteborgs Stad Kultur. Two stages under one organisation count as one unit, as Piacenza's three halls did. Dockteaterhuset i Wadköping is a permanent stage in an eighteenth-century building in the Wadköping cultural quarter by the Svartå in Örebro, a non-profit association that has existed since 1973 under various names, playing mainly puppetry for children from two upwards in its own theatre and on tour, supported by Örebro kommun and Region Örebro län. The stage is Marionetteatern, founded in 1958 by Michael Meschke, part of Stockholms stadsteater since 2003, home stage in the Kulturhuset at Sergels torg while also playing Skärholmen, Vällingby and Parkteatern. A named puppetry unit inside a municipal theatre, which is what the ruling of 2026-07-27 calls a stage. One refusal, and the ground had to be corrected. Byteatern in Kalmar was founded in 1971 and began as a puppet theatre for children, sailing the Swedish coast in the ship Helene with a café, film, music and puppetry; it has been the Kalmar county theatre since 1992 and plays in a newly built performance house. The first version of this record excluded it on its mission statement — that it shall be a theatre for the whole of Kalmar county — which is a sentence about geography and audience and proves nothing about form. The real ground is in its own history, which says that in the generational change of 2012 to 2020 the narrative and the actor took the central place and that Byteatern also leaves behind the pronounced work with puppets and masks. UNIMA Sverige does not list it among the puppet groups either. A theatre that came out of puppetry and says it has left it is not a puppetry unit. Five, and the upper bound is 6: Staffan Björklunds Teater in Skåne appears in the same directory with a theatre workshop and a garden venue, and was not read.

observations.reasoning: Web check of 2026-07-27, searched in the country's own language. No establishment retained. Stockholm University of the Arts, the only public higher arts school in the field after the mergers of 2014 and 2020, offers two puppetry courses, Introduction to Puppet Theatre and Introduction to Puppet Play, both as standalone courses outside any degree, one run in cooperation with the Marionetteatern at Kulturhuset stadsteatern. A standalone course is not a specialised degree-granting higher education programme: the denominator is not satisfied. The previous 0.5 was the midpoint of an estimated range. Caveat: this rests on search summaries, hence estimate and an upper bound of 1.
